title: Preallocate EXPLAIN schema keys
description: Avoid generic format! allocation work when EXPLAIN builds schema:<table> lookup keys from known table-name length.
implementation: Added explain_schema_key_for_table() with explicit capacity for schema:<table>.
Replaced explain_table_access() schema lookup key construction.
Replaced load_explain_schema() schema lookup key construction.
Added unit coverage for helper output and capacity.
result: EXPLAIN schema-key construction now reserves capacity from known table-name length while preserving access path reporting, ANALYZE statistics estimates, join order estimates, and DDL behavior.
